from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List

class MonthlyHousingStart(BaseModel):
    """A single monthly data point extracted from a housing construction report."""
    release_date: str | None = Field(description="The date the report was issued, used to resolve data precedence")
    month: str | None = Field(description="The specific month the data corresponds to (e.g., '2022-08')")
    region: str | None = Field(description="The geographic region or total designation (e.g., 'South', 'Total United States')")
    value: float | None = Field(description="The seasonally adjusted annual rate of housing starts")
    status: str | None = Field(description="Any status marking on the data (e.g., 'preliminary', 'revised')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    monthly_housing_starts: List[MonthlyHousingStart]
